claim_boundary: Only the successful level-1 and level-2 prefixes from the sealed V3 artifact are admitted as historical bootstrap evidence. Level 3+ is the fresh transfer boundary. No source-derived game rule is admitted.

candidate_law.transfer_witness_policy: resolve mouse:leftmost on the fresh level and repeat while protected state changes, stopping on level progress, game over, no-change, or 32 actions

prohibited_credit: bootstrap replay does not count as transfer
source code or hidden game rules do not count as evidence
a model-assisted level-3 success does not count as compiled transfer
